reviews.review: 10/10 great game unlimited amount of different communities and endless supply of mods

Yeah, this game was great… actually, scratch that—it’s still absolutely amazing.

Arma 3 has somehow managed to stay relevant for over a decade, and even now it continues to outperform many modern military simulation titles in terms of scale, freedom, and depth. Despite being around 13 years old, it still holds up visually and mechanically, especially when you consider the complexity it offers. No other game quite matches the same level of combined realism, sandbox freedom, and modded content that Arma 3 provides.

One of the biggest reasons it has such incredible replayability is the sheer amount of content available through both official support and community mods. From large-scale milsim operations to survival scenarios, roleplay servers, and custom missions, the game can basically become whatever you want it to be. You can sink thousands of hours into it and still find completely new experiences, especially when playing with organised groups or well-built scenarios. It’s the kind of game that never really runs out of things to do.

Even after the release of newer titles in the series, the developers have continued to support and update Arma 3, which has helped keep its community alive and active. That ongoing support, combined with the massive modding scene, is a big reason why it has lasted so long. It’s not just surviving—it’s still competing at a high level in the milsim space.

The community itself is another huge strength. While public servers can sometimes feel chaotic or overly serious, there are still plenty of welcoming, friendly groups—especially in regional communities like Australia, where players tend to focus more on teamwork and having fun. Finding the right group completely changes the experience and brings out the best parts of the game.

Overall, Arma 3 is one of those rare games that just refuses to die. Even after thousands of hours, it still has something new to offer, and it continues to stand as one of the most complete and flexible military simulation sandboxes ever made.
